newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pharmacia 1997 EPS estimate lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pharmacia 1997 EPS estimate lowered.

text.p: --Smith Barney pharmaceuticals analyst Jane Kearns said she lowered her 1997 earnings estimate for Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc to $2.10 per share from $2.25 per share.
--Shares in the Swedish-American drug manufacturer were off 1-1/4 to 36-1/2.

--Kearns said she made the adjustment based on company comments following its report of 1996 earnings of $1.90 per share, excluding non-recurring items, compared to $1.79 per share in 1995 on the same basis.
